title: Harmonic approximation lemma (Simon 5.3.1)
statement: For n >= 1 and eps > 0 there is delta > 0 such that: if B is the open unit ball of R^n, f in L^2(B), g in L^2(B;R^n) with integral_B f grad zeta = - integral_B zeta g for all zeta in C_c^infinity(B), integral_B |g|^2 <= 1, and |integral_B g . grad zeta| <= delta M whenever zeta in C_c^infinity(B) and |grad zeta| <= M everywhere, then there is u harmonic on B (C^2 near each point with Laplacian 0) with integral_B |grad u|^2 <= 1 and integral_B |u - f|^2 <= eps (extended integrals).
